messages:
harper: hey everyone, i'm harper and i started today (platform PM). i'm stuck at the last step of SSO: after Okta prompts to enroll Okta Verify, the flow redirects back to the login page and shows 'Activation error'. i also haven't gotten the 1Password org invite. any pointers? @rachel ?

it-bot: Created ticket IT-2101 for @harper. If this blocks your laptop setup, run `/pager rachel` to escalate.

rachel: welcome @harper! that redirect usually means the session cookie was cleared or an existing factor blocked activation. two quick checks: try an incognito window and disable browser extensions. also check if your company email exists in Google Workspace yet.

harper: tried incognito, same result. email not active yet (says account pending).

rachel: ok i'll check provisioning. sometimes the 1Password invite gets sent before email provisioning completes and bounces. i'll reissue the 1Password invite and reset your Okta factors so you can do manual setup. give me ~10m.

dennis: hey @harper, welcome to the team! once you're in i'll add you to the project boards and invite you to standups. ping me if you need access to the private roadmap doc.

emma: hi @harper — i'm your onboarding buddy. if 1Password doesn't show up, check spam and promotions. i'll DM you a temporary link to the handbook.

it-bot: IT-2101 updated by rachel. Action: Resend 1Password invite; Reset MFA factors. ETA 15m.

rachel: re-sent the 1Password invite to the personal email on file and reset MFA. try signing in at https://redwood.okta.com and choose "Can't scan?" -> Manual setup, then paste secret into Okta Verify or add it to 1Password as a one-time password.

harper: got the 1Password invite to my personal email, accepted and can see the OTP entry. did manual setup with the secret and Okta Verify activated. email is now provisioned and i can access Sheets. thanks all! :tada:

dennis: awesome, welcome aboard! i'll add you to the infra project later today.

emma: yay! let me know when you finish the setup checklist and i'll walk you through repo onboarding later.

it-bot: Ticket IT-2101 closed by rachel.
